title: The held-out file holds about 100 real kb-user questions, with a measured answer rate and a floor set from it
goal: kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv grows from 20 to between 95 and 105 rows, each a question a kb user would ask, worded as a session would ask it (taken from the query log store's lookup records where one fits, placeholders for private names), covering present knowledge (expect good with the answering article), partial knowledge (expect weak, or good with allow_weak) and absent knowledge (expect none); the rows are written from reading the articles, never from a pack or eval run of the new questions, and committed before their first eval run, which is the one measurement; no row rewords a lookup_eval.csv row or a doc2query expansion, and none is added to lookup_eval.csv, the off-kb list or the expansions; the measured pass count is recorded, and the fitness test's --min floor is set from it by the operator's answer to gate floor, in kb/_self/tools.md and kb/_self/token-efficiency.md

run: import csv,sys;r=list(csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv',encoding='utf-8')));g=sum(x['expect_verdict']=='good' and not x['allow_weak'] for x in r);p=sum(x['expect_verdict']=='weak' or (x['expect_verdict']=='good' and x['allow_weak']=='yes') for x in r);n=sum(x['expect_verdict']=='none' for x in r);ids=[x['id'] for x in r];print(len(r),g,p,n);sys.exit(0 if 95<=len(r)<=105 and g>=50 and p>=10 and n>=10 and len(set(ids))==len(ids) and all(i.startswith('HO-') for i in ids) else 1)

import re,csv,sys,subprocess;t=open('kb/_self/tools.md',encoding='utf-8').read()+open('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md',encoding='utf-8').read();m=set(re.findall(r'lookup_heldout\.csv --root public --min (\d+)',t));n=len(list(csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv',encoding='utf-8'))));r=re.search(r'Rate: at least (\d+) of (\d+); measured (\d+) of (\d+)',t);print(m,n,r and r.groups());ok=n>=95 and len(m)==1 and r and int(r.group(2))==n==int(r.group(4)) and r.group(1)==next(iter(m)) and int(r.group(3))>=int(r.group(1));sys.exit(1 if not ok else subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','eval','--file','kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv','--root','public','--min',next(iter(m))]).returncode)

notes: Premise (run 2026-10-14 on ae319c43c5): lookup_heldout.csv holds 20 rows, all expect good; the fitness test runs --min 16 (tools.md, token-efficiency.md). bench_pool.PLAN samples 20 held-out ids by seed only at pool build: the grown file leaves the committed bench_pool.csv as it is; a paid pool re-run over the grown file is a separate draft for the operator. The goal research story ST-bwj6gyfj must not touch lookup_heldout.csv.
